graph.measure: independent normalized Haar on20 oriented links
graph.full_action: sum over11 distinct face coefficients k_f*Tr(U_face_f)/2; internal face counted once
graph.outer_action: sum over10 outer face coefficients only; shared coefficient0
graph.energy_scale: no Hamiltonian energy scale is defined by these Euclidean couplings

low_support_inventory.interpretation: necessary no-leaf supports; degree-two intertwiner proof fixes a common spin, and the energy cutoff leaves only spin one half

six_edge_witness.scope: exact physical Wilson-loop state in Q, not a sampled tail eigenvector

fourth_moment_inventory.reason: this low-order agreement follows from actual graph integration; it is not a full distribution factorization

physical_contract.Hilbert: untruncated L2 of SU(2)^20 restricted to all-vertex Gauss invariants
physical_contract.projection: vacuum and all eleven fundamental face characters
physical_contract.operator_domain: elliptic electric domain; bounded Wilson perturbation
